name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_ResetSignInState
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall/__thiscall(ECX = the 0x3f0-byte XenonSystemManager), no stack args. Called at 00a40ff4 as the last-but-one step of BSP_XLiveSystem_Initialize (00a40df0) and reused as the manager's reset path. Invokes the stub stored at manager +0x20 only when +0x8c is non-zero; clears the sign-in fields at +0x119, +0x11a and +0x11c (set to 1) unless +0x3bd is set; sets +0x124 to -1; empties the four-byte-stride vector at +0x364/+0x368 by moving its end back to its begin; sets the state word at +0x3b0 to 0, logs ' ...   XenonSystemManager  ChangeState To %d' through 004254b0, then sets +0x3b4 and +0x3b8 to 1. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_DrainNotifications
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(XenonSystemManager*). The only XNotifyGetNext loop the frame reaches: sole caller 00a409f0, which BSP_Game_PollPlatformSessionEvents calls at 004db2bc. Re-creates the listener with qwAreas = 2Fh when manager+1Ch is -1, logs ' ...   NotifyGet %x %x' for every notification, and dispatches twelve ids: 09h sets manager+3E8h from the parameter after calling the hook in 00f8abec; 0Ah runs 00a3f440; 0Bh calls the hook in 00f8abf0, which nothing in the image writes; 0Eh runs 00a3e600; 15h compares a built path against setup.exe; 16h runs XLiveUpdateSystem then _exit(0); 02000001h handles connection changes, with 001510F0h calling 00a3fa70(1) and 80151005h setting manager+128h; 02000002h calls XInviteGetAcceptedInfo, sets manager+31h at 00a4033c and REP MOVSDs 15h dwords of XINVITE_INFO into manager+32h at 00a4034c; 02000003h logs only; 02000007h sets manager+30h; 04000002h and 04000003h call 00f8a2fc virtual +28h. Ids outside the list are dropped. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_XLiveSystem_Initialize
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); called at 0073dc7c after the window title is pushed through DAT_0109cf04 virtual slot 4. Reconstructed in packet app_init_audio_online. __thiscall(ECX = a 0x3f0-byte XenonSystemManager from operator new at 0073dc50), RET 8: the caller pushes 00735510 and 00735520, two 14-byte image stubs of the form 'PUSH 6|4; PUSH 0x8001; PUSH ECX; CALL 00a6d3f2; RET', which land in +0x20 and +0x24. Base ctor 00a3f530; vtable 00d2413c; +0x10 = 1; the sign-in and notification fields are zeroed. Logs ' ...  XenonSystemManager Start Initialization  ...' (00d2435c) through 004254b0, then builds a 28-byte XLIVE_INITIALIZE_INFO on the stack: +0x00 cbSize = 0x1c, +0x04 = 0, +0x08 = the D3D9 device from BSP_D3D9Renderer_GetDevice (00b1fef0) on DAT_00f8d394, +0x0c = DAT_00f8d394 + 0x1a28 (the present parameters inside the renderer), +0x10 = GetUserDefaultLangID as a WORD, +0x14 and +0x18 = 0. XLiveInitializeEx(&info, 0x20029900) at 00a40f46 and its HRESULT is discarded. Logs ' ...  XenonSystemManager XLiveInitialized  ...' (00d2432c); 00a4c250 on the sub-object at +0x3ac; XOnlineStartup; XWSAStartup(0x0202, WSADATA) with the returned low word checked byte by byte and XWSACleanup called unless it is exactly 2.2; XNetSetSystemLinkPort(XSocketNTOHS(0x0c02)), the Xbox LIVE system link port 3074 in network byte order; XNotifyCreateListener(qwAreas = 0x2f) into +0x1c, with ' ...  XenonSystemManager XNotifyCreateListener  ... SUCCEED ' (00d242ec) logged only when the handle is neither 0 nor -1. Ends with BSP_XenonSystemManager_ResetSignInState (00a40020) and one pump of the state machine at 00a409f0. xlive.dll is a plain static import, so there is no path in this routine for XLive being absent. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_AUDIO_ONLINE.md; reports/app_init_audio_online.json; docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md.

name: BSP_OnlineAwards_GrantIfSessionActive
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_shell_entry, read-only analysis. __thiscall(this, int awardId), RET 4, ECX = the online/system manager at 00F8ABE8. Forwards to 00a41030 only when this+119h is set, this+11Ah is set, and the per-slot state at this+8Ch + this+11Ch*4 is 1 or 2; otherwise it returns without doing anything. 004e4000 calls it at 004e43a7 with the id 006b8da0 resolved from the name map at 00E19900, after checking 1 <= id <= 99, 00a3e520 and 004b44f0 on the same object. The gate values are not named; the online subsystem at 00F8ABE8 is outside this packet. Evidence: docs/GAME_FRONTEND_ENTRY.md.
